project: Geometric Orbit Representatives for Unaligned 3D Tokenization
institution: Chair of Multimodal Machine Learning, ScaDS.AI Dresden/Leipzig
changes: None; copied from the authors' presentation asset.
scope: Conceptual pipeline, not measured token activations or an experimental reconstruction pair.
roles: Fixed geometric representative: PCA and deterministic axis lock
Learned representative-frame SDF decoder, frozen during completion

result_sources.representative_stability: Paper Table 1: no-retraining stress test, independent jitter, no yaw minimization, common reference for frame comparison.
result_sources.effective_support: Paper Figure 5 and supplementary soft-collapse table: matched K=8192, full 5216-shape ShapeNet test split.
result_sources.completion: Primary completion split at 50% masking: 97.23% bit accuracy and 78.01% token exactness.
result_sources.relaxed_decoding: Paper decoded-geometry table at 75% masking, 512 maps; drift is oracle-relative failure, not ground-truth reconstruction error.
